title: Dhammo
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 3 Lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtassa pariyādiṇṇa-cittassa bhikkhave Devadattassa kusalo dhammo samucchedam agamā || || 4 Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 5 oSikkhitabbanti || || Tatiyaṃ || ||
